central_question: Writing ở miền nam Mesopotamia đã cùng các thiết chế hình thành, trở thành capacity multiplier, thích nghi và cuối cùng sống sót qua recovery như thế nào?
proposed_answer: Writing không đơn độc tạo civilization; institutional pressure và information practices tạo proto-cuneiform, rồi trained communities embedded records in procedures, producing a bounded feedback loop.

sections.title: Một mảnh đất sét không chịu nói
sections.narrative_job: Thiết lập object, mystery và causal question bằng một tablet sớm; nó lưu relations nhưng không cho phép chuyện phát minh đơn giản.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả xem writing như phát minh hoàn chỉnh do người Sumer tạo ra để ghi ngôn ngữ.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả hiểu earliest evidence nằm trên ngưỡng tranh luận; câu hỏi thật là nó trở thành hạ tầng xã hội thế nào.
sections.question: Nếu tablet sớm nhất chưa kể được câu hoàn chỉnh, vì sao nó quan trọng?
sections.payoff: Giá trị đầu tiên là làm quantities, categories và relations tồn tại ngoài trí nhớ tức thời.
anchor_requirements: P005390/MMA 1988.433.2; Met Public Domain image; preserve uncertain provenance/language.
Declare Uruk IV/III ranges and writing-threshold dispute.
sections.bridge_in: Cold open on physical object and constrained modern reading.
sections.bridge_out: Step backward into earlier information practices.
sections.boundary: Không giải thích toàn bộ formation hoặc tuyên bố world-first.
sections.risk: Definition must stay attached to what the object can/cannot do.

sections.title: Trước chữ viết, đã có cả một hệ sinh thái
sections.narrative_job: Thay token-ladder bằng ecology: counting, bullae, seals, images, numerical tablets và metrology.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả tìm một tổ tiên duy nhất.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả thấy nhiều tools song song; numerical continuity mạnh nhưng universal genealogy không đứng vững.
sections.question: Chữ viết đi ra từ token, hay từ nhiều tools bị kéo vào cùng một bài toán?
sections.payoff: Institutional selection recombined an existing information ecology.
anchor_requirements: Material comparison: late tokens/bullae, sealings, numerical tablet, proto-cuneiform.
Every object labeled as bounded function, not inevitable step.
sections.bridge_in: Early tablet inherits practices rather than appearing ex nihilo.
sections.bridge_out: Ecology supplies components; scale pressure explains consolidation.
sections.risk: Avoid object catalogue; each object answers an information problem.

sections.title: Khi quy mô vượt quá trí nhớ cục bộ
sections.narrative_job: Đặt institutional scale as major selection pressure; separate accounting, exchange, redistribution, labor, obligation and ownership.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả biết tools có sẵn nhưng chưa biết vì sao system consolidated.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả hiểu stable records were selected by classification/coordination problems; evidence supports co-development, not one-way causation.
sections.question: Điều gì trong đời sống đô thị khiến durable records đáng trả chi phí?
sections.payoff: Institutions create demand for stable classifications: forward arrow of feedback, not yet return arrow.
anchor_requirements: Uruk IV–III corpus as qualitative evidence; no uncited percentage.
Mechanism matrix for transfer, redistribution, labor, obligation, ownership, exchange.
sections.bridge_in: Many tools become a system when coordination rewards standardization.
sections.bridge_out: Pressure explains selection; next inspect technical state.
sections.boundary: Không chứng minh record đã làm institution powerful; return arrow ở P07.
sections.risk: Preserve alternative functions and corpus bias.

sections.title: Một hệ thống học cách ghi ngôn ngữ
sections.narrative_job: Theo dõi medium, layout, sign values and language without alphabet teleology.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả đồng nhất earliest marks với mature wedge-shaped language-complete cuneiform.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả tách medium, ductus, layout, script and language; capacity expands gradually and stays logo-syllabic.
sections.question: Tablet đi từ giữ quantities/categories tới names, clauses and languages thế nào?
sections.payoff: Accumulated graphic, metrological and phonetic adaptations—not a march to alphabet.
anchor_requirements: Contrast incised proto-cuneiform with later wedges.
One layout and one repeated phonetic/logo-syllabic example.
sections.bridge_in: Institutional demand selected an initially bounded system.
sections.bridge_out: Capacity is not use; next examine actual uptake.
sections.boundary: Không catalogue every sign stage or imply alphabet endpoint.
sections.risk: Technical detail must change audience model of capability.

sections.title: Từ account đến những thế giới có thể được ghi lại
sections.narrative_job: Show functional expansion through selected objects, not genre catalogue.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả biết script can encode more and may assume uses follow automatically.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả sees administrative, lexical, epistolary and literary-memory uses appearing unevenly.
sections.question: Khi writing could say more, xã hội thực sự dùng nó làm gì?
sections.payoff: Writing organizes knowledge, reports commands and reconstructs memory while administration persists.
anchor_requirements: P005390 briefly returns.
MMA 86.11.111 as exceptional letter.
P228744 and ETCSL 3.1.19 as mediated school/composite evidence.
sections.bridge_out: Objects show what; next ask who produces and sustains them.
sections.boundary: Không treat first-person as interiority or text as enforcement.
sections.risk: P005390/MMA letter carry weight; school/composite cases stay compact.

sections.title: Những người giữ cho dấu hiệu còn sống
sections.narrative_job: Turn marks into infrastructure through scribes, training, copying, calculation and communities.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả treats script as self-operating technology.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả understands reproducibility depended on trained people/institutions with restricted, changing access.
sections.question: Ai biến clay marks thành system surviving beyond one transaction?
sections.payoff: Operational unit is community able to write, read, copy, classify and teach.
anchor_requirements: House F Nippur as high-resolution but exceptional training context.
P228744 as lexical-copy witness; Penn image uncleared.
sections.bridge_out: Specialists connect record to authentication, archive and authority.
sections.boundary: Không estimate literacy or project Old Babylonian edubba to Uruk.
sections.risk: Later evidence shows mature infrastructure, not origin.

sections.title: Khi record trở thành năng lực hành động
sections.narrative_job: Test return arrow from record through procedure to coordination, obligation and power, with archive bias.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả knows institutions demanded writing but not whether writing changed them.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả accepts bounded feedback: embedded records enlarged capacities and redistributed visibility, but did not enforce alone.
sections.question: Một record bắt đầu thay đổi thế giới ở mắt xích nào?
sections.payoff: Tablet → trained agent → authentication → archive/retrieval → authority/action; later archives test capacity multiplication.
anchor_requirements: Ur III Umma labor categories.
Puzriš-Dagan coordination/retrieval archive.
MMA letter returns as non-compliance counterexample.
sections.bridge_in: Specialists supply links between mark and action.
sections.boundary: Không back-project Ur III effect size to Uruk; keep unwritten domains visible.
sections.risk: Pair every capacity with agent, beneficiary and invisible domain.

sections.title: Sống lâu bằng cách trở thành thứ khác
sections.narrative_job: Explain spread through adaptation; separate script, language and institution.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả equates survival with unchanged Sumerian language/culture.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả tracks cuneiform script, learned Sumerian and reproducing institutions separately.
sections.question: Làm sao tradition sống khi ngôn ngữ và state đầu tiên thay đổi?
sections.payoff: Survival comes from costly adaptation through specialists, courts, diplomacy and curricula.
anchor_requirements: Akkadian adoption as primary transformation.
Hittite selective-transfer case.
sections.bridge_in: Infrastructure becomes portable through carriers and change.
sections.bridge_out: Dependence on costly reproduction creates vulnerability.
sections.boundary: Không write global history of every cuneiform language.
sections.risk: Name carrier and transformation cost for spread claims.

sections.title: Ngày truyền thống sống ngừng tự tái tạo
sections.narrative_job: Narrate multicausal contraction; distinguish last object, competence and material survival.
sections.entry_state: Khán giả expects one conquest or last tablet.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả sees uneven contraction and decisive break: clay remains, competent reproduction disappears.
sections.question: System chết khi không ai viết, không ai dạy, hay tablet cuối bị chôn?
sections.payoff: Endpoint is loss of institutional reproduction; 75 CE is latest-known evidence, not extinction date.
anchor_requirements: Latest-known astronomical tablet, 75 CE, discovery-sensitive.
Contrast active competence with silent material survival.
sections.bridge_in: Adaptation works only while institutions pay training cost.
sections.bridge_out: Durable clay becomes archive no living reader can access.
sections.boundary: Không select one sufficient cause or synchronized endpoint.

sections.title: Khi đất sét học cách nói lần thứ hai
sections.narrative_job: Resolve title through cumulative decipherment and bounded legacy; return to opening object.
sections.entry_state: Clay survives mute; verdict on writing and civilization remains.
sections.exit_state: Khán giả understands co-development plus feedback and recovery-mediated afterlife.
sections.question: Sau competence break, điều gì thật sự sống sót—and writing đã tạo ra gì?
sections.payoff: Writing neither created Sumer alone nor merely mirrored it; embedded practice expanded bounded capacities and modern comparison rebuilt access.
anchor_requirements: Copied inscriptions → Old Persian → Behistun → tested Akkadian → reconstructed Sumerian.
Return to opening tablet; distinguish readable from uncertain.
sections.bridge_in: Material survival without competence creates recovery, not continuous inheritance.
sections.bridge_out: Close causal question; no generic lesson or smartphone analogy.
sections.boundary: Không hero-only decipherment or direct modern lineage.
sections.risk: Keep archaeology concise; make recovery pay off causal model.
